chunks: And through his chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever loves us, the Ahl al-Bayt, Allah the Exalted will resurrect him in a state of security on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: Ahl al-Bayt (the People of the House/Holy Household)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for loving the Ahl al-Bayt on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith underscores the centrality of *mawaddah* (affection) for the Ahl al-Bayt as a criterion for divine security (*aman*) on the Day of Resurrection. It reflects the Shia theological emphasis that love for the Prophet's purified household is not merely an emotional attachment but a means of attaining salvation and protection from the terrors of the Hereafter.
